name: Aram Uhm
career: Commercial property leasing coordinator for mixed-use developments
bio: Aram spends his weekdays touring retail vacancies, juggling tenant calls, and getting distracted by construction crews when a bulldozer is working near one of his properties. After work, he unwinds with his boyfriend by watching boxing previews, Camaro build videos, and the occasional road-rage compilation while promising himself he will finally organize the stack of leasing folders on his kitchen table. His faith is a steady part of his routine, especially gospel playlists and short devotionals about renewal, though he can spiral into late-night worries about privacy settings, headlines, and End Times videos. Surprisingly, he keeps a small balcony pond with rescued feeder goldfish and writes their names on tiny waterproof labels.
